test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 6

questions.question: One-third of a journey is covered at a speed of 48 km/hr, the next one-third of the journey is covered at a speed of 54 km/hr and the remaining journey is covered at a speed of 44 km/hr. The average speed (in km/hr, rounded off to 1 decimal place) for the entire journey is:
A typist takes 40 minutes to type 8 pages. How many pages will he type in 75 minutes?
Rama purchased three sarees for ₹1,720 each and six bottles of honey for ₹90 each from a supermarket. On the purchase, she received a rebate of 12%. How much amount (in ₹) did Rama pay in total?
The difference between the compound interest (when interest is compounded annually) and the simple interest, if ₹54,800 is deposited at 10% rate of interest per annum for 2 years, is:
Find the simple interest (in ₹), if a sum of ₹400 is borrowed for 8.5 years at 20% per annum rate of interest.
